ValidationRule.description: this validation prevent users to add line items on invoices when invoice is not in draft status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Invoice__c ), ISCHANGED( Line_Amount__c ) ), TEXT(Invoice__r.Status__c) <> "Draft" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Line items and Amount can only be added when the Invoice is in 'Draft' status.
